SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, gm.group_id FROM group_members gm JOIN groups g ON gm.group_id = g.group_id JOIN users u ON gm.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE g.group_id = #{id} AND g.group_type = 'C1' AND gm.is_active = 'O1' AND gm.is_primary = 'Y' AND u.is_active='O1'
WHERE u.user_name = #{name} AND g.group_type = 'C1' AND gm.is_active = 'O1' AND gm.is_primary = 'Y' AND u.is_active='O1'
ORDER BY gm.group_id

SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name AS name, g.group_name, g.group_id, r.role_name FROM group_members gm JOIN groups g ON gm.group_id = g.group_id JOIN roles r ON gm.role_id = r.role_id JOIN users u ON gm.user_id = u.user_id WHERE g.group_type = 'C2' AND g.is_active = 'O1' AND u.is_active = 'O1' ORDER BY gm.group_id
